data.question: How far in advance should I order a custom cake?
data.answer: We recommend placing custom cake orders at least 48-72 hours in advance. For elaborate wedding cakes or large events, please book 2-4 weeks ahead to ensure availability and design consultations.

data.question: Do you offer eggless cake options?
data.answer: Yes! We offer a wide range of eggless cakes across all categories including chocolate, vanilla, fruit, and premium flavours. All eggless options are clearly marked on our menu.

data.question: What are your delivery areas and charges?
data.answer: Delivery areas, charges and lead times are set in your shop's Commerce settings — update this answer to match them.

data.question: Can I customize the design and flavour of my cake?
data.answer: Absolutely! Our bakers can create custom designs based on your theme, colours and preferences. Share your ideas during checkout, or get in touch for a design consultation.

data.question: How should I store my cake after delivery?
data.answer: Cream cakes should be refrigerated and consumed within 24-48 hours. Fondant cakes can be stored at room temperature in a cool, dry place for up to 3 days. Always bring to room temperature before serving.

data.question: Do you provide cake stands for wedding events?
data.answer: Yes, premium cake stands are available for wedding orders. Mention your requirement during inquiry and our team will include options in the quote.

data.question: What is your cancellation policy?
data.answer: Orders cancelled 48 hours before the scheduled date receive a full refund. Cancellations within 48 hours may incur a preparation fee depending on customization level.

data.question: Do you offer midnight delivery for birthdays?
data.answer: Midnight delivery is available in select metro cities for orders placed at least 24 hours in advance. Additional charges may apply.
